literal: The departing guest having tended, the coming guest waiting for he who remains, a good guest to the heavenly ones.
translation: He who hospitably sends off the departing guest and waits expectantly for the incoming guest will be welcomed as an honored guest by the gods of heaven.
modern: செல்லும் விருந்தினரைப் பேணி, வரும் விருந்தினரை எதிர்பார்த்து காத்திருப்பவன், வானுலகில் வாழும் தேவர்களுக்கு நல்ல விருந்தினன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the continuous nature of true hospitality. A virtuous householder does not merely host those who arrive, but actively cares for departing guests while eagerly anticipating the next ones. Such selfless dedication to others elevates the householder's character to a divine level. Ultimately, when they enter the heavenly realm, the celestial beings themselves will welcome them with the same high honor as a cherished guest.
